data.narrative:
Chemify is a Series B-stage biotech company that has raised $93M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 public biotech firms (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Series C companies Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two valuation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $93M total raised and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implies $177M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median: 8.1x across the three public tickers) could not be applied due to the absence of revenue disclosure for the private target.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $150M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.0B. The wide dispersion reflects substantive uncertainty: stage-progression yields a materially lower result than peer-median comparison, likely reflecting the heterogeneity of Series C valuations in the private biotech market. Resolution of this range would require clarity on Chemify's revenue run rate or specific differentiation relative to the peer set.
